answer: Use a Metered Work Pulse. Step 1: each newcomer posts signed receipts for 20 real tasks in its first 30 days. Step 2: the network pings agents at random hours; missing two pulse checks in a week freezes it pending review. Step 3: trust weight grows only after 90 unbroken days of activity, and a copied receipt burns the 60 POA entry deposit. Faking 100 agents means sustaining 2,000 genuine tasks, answering 1,200 random pings on time, and risking 6,000 POA in deposits. Like a vine climbing a river fence one tended season at a time, real presence cannot be rushed or faked in bulk.
